# 0) Libraries

```{r, warning=F, message=F}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(stringr)
library(terra)
library(foreign)       # read.dbf
library(exactextractr) # majority pixels
library(glue)
```


# 1) Target Input

```{r}
# Selection (already defined earlier in your doc; shown here for completeness)
target_address <- NA_character_
target_pid     <- "1700922"
target_crop    <- "Carrot_seed"     # value taken from your dataset column CROP
```


# 2) Config

```{r}
# Paths & CRS
csv_path    <- "parcel_crop_suitability_counts_master.csv"   # your saved file
initial_crs <- 28355                                         # WKT CRS used in the CSV

# --- LIST WMS (for backdrop) ---
wms_url <- "https://services.thelist.tas.gov.au/arcgis/services/Public/EnterpriseSuitabilityMapping2018/MapServer/WMSServer"

# Canonicaliser
canon <- function(s) tolower(gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(s)))

# --- define these *outside* the function ---
esm_layers <- c(
  "Barley" = "0",
  "Blueberries [nhb]" = "1",
  "Blueberries [shb]" = "2",
  "Carrots" = "3",
  "Carrot seed" = "4",
  "Cherries" = "5",
  "Cocksfoot Continental" = "6",
  "Cocksfoot Mediterranean" = "7",
  "Eucalyptus Globulus" = "8",
  "Eucalyptus Nitens" = "9",
  "Hazelnuts" = "10",
  "Industrial Hemp" = "11",
  "Linseed" = "12",
  "Lucerne" = "13",
  "Olives" = "14",
  "Onions" = "15",
  "Phalaris" = "16",
  "Pinus Radiata" = "17",
  "Poppies" = "18",
  "Potatoes" = "19",
  "Pyrethrum" = "20",
  "Raspberries" = "21",
  "Red Clover" = "22",
  "Rye Grass" = "23",
  "Sparkling Wine Grapes" = "24",
  "Strawberries" = "25",
  "Strawberry Clover" = "26",
  "Table Wine Grapes" = "27",
  "Tall Fescue Continental" = "28",
  "Tall Fescue Mediterranean" = "29",
  "Wheat" = "30",
  "White Clover" = "31",
  "Enterprise Versatility Index" = "32",
  "Enterprise Versatility Index - Pastures" = "33"
)

# Your dataset -> WMS title aliases (keys are canonicalised/lowercase)
aliases <- c(
  "carrot_seed"             = "Carrot seed",
  "cocksfootcontinental"    = "Cocksfoot Continental",
  "cocksfootmediterranean"  = "Cocksfoot Mediterranean",
  "eucglobulus"             = "Eucalyptus Globulus",
  "eucnitens"               = "Eucalyptus Nitens",
  "industrialhemp"          = "Industrial Hemp",
  "ryegrass"                = "Rye Grass",
  "sparklingwine"           = "Sparkling Wine Grapes",
  "strawberryclover"        = "Strawberry Clover",
  "tablewine"               = "Table Wine Grapes",
  "tallfescuecontinental"   = "Tall Fescue Continental",
  "tallfescuemediterranean" = "Tall Fescue Mediterranean",
  "redclover"               = "Red Clover",
  "whiteclover"             = "White Clover"
)

# --- corrected resolver (rename the parameter to avoid self-reference) ---
resolve_wms_layer <- function(crop, layers = esm_layers, alias_map = aliases) {
  k <- canon(crop)
  # use alias if present
  title <- if (!is.null(alias_map) && length(alias_map) && k %in% names(alias_map)) {
    alias_map[[k]]
  } else {
    crop
  }
  idx <- match(canon(title), canon(names(layers)))
  if (is.na(idx)) {
    stop("No WMS layer id for crop label: '", crop,
         "'. Check `alias_map` or `esm_layers`.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  unname(layers[idx])
}

# --- usage ---
# target_crop <- "Cherries"   # or "RyeGrass", "Carrot_seed", etc.
esm_layer_id <- resolve_wms_layer(target_crop, esm_layers, aliases)

# --- Fixed legend (same order/colors you’ve been using) ---
classes <- c(
  "1.0 Well suited",
  "1.1 Well suited (with soil mgmt)",
  "2.0 Suitable",
  "2.1 Suitable (with soil mgmt)",
  "3.0 Moderately suitable",
  "3.1 Moderately suitable (with soil mgmt)",
  "4.0 Unsuitable"
)
cols <- c("#4B0082","#5A4CB2","#62C6D4","#8CD1B6","#58C39D","#A3D98A","#FFE550")
```


# 3) Load CSV → make geometries (no cleaning)

```{r}
# Read the master CSV that already contains: PID, POT_PID, MUNICIPALITY, FULL_ADDRESS,
# COUNT, CLASS_LABEL, CROP, GEOMETRY (parcel WKT), ADDRESS_WKT (point WKT).
master <- readr::read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# One geometry per PID (geometry is duplicated across class rows)
geom_per_pid <- master %>%
  distinct(PID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    parcel_sfc  = sf::st_as_sfc(GEOMETRY, crs = initial_crs),
    address_sfc = sf::st_as_sfc(ADDRESS_WKT, crs = initial_crs)
  )

# Helpers to fetch a single parcel row by address or PID
pick_row <- function(df, addr = NA_character_, pid = NA_character_) {
  if (!is.na(addr)) {
    hit <- df %>% filter(str_squish(str_to_upper(FULL_ADDRESS)) == str_squish(str_to_upper(addr)))
    if (nrow(hit) > 0) return(hit %>% slice(1))
  }
  if (!is.na(pid)) {
    hit <- df %>% filter(PID == pid)
    if (nrow(hit) > 0) return(hit %>% slice(1))
  }
  stop("No matching parcel found for given address/PID.")
}

row1 <- pick_row(geom_per_pid, addr = target_address, pid = target_pid)

parcel_sf <- row1 %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, FULL_ADDRESS, GEOMETRY) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(wkt = "GEOMETRY", crs = initial_crs)

addr_sf <- row1 %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, FULL_ADDRESS, ADDRESS_WKT) %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(wkt = "ADDRESS_WKT", crs = initial_crs)

# safety: fix invalid parcel geom; fallback address point if needed
if (!all(sf::st_is_valid(parcel_sf))) parcel_sf <- sf::st_make_valid(parcel_sf)
if (nrow(addr_sf) == 0 || any(sf::st_is_empty(addr_sf))) {
  addr_sf <- sf::st_point_on_surface(parcel_sf)
}

```


# 4) Summarize counts for the selected PID + crop (from CSV only)

```{r}
majority_tab <- master %>%
  filter(PID == row1$PID, CROP == target_crop) %>%
  group_by(CLASS_LABEL) %>%
  summarise(COUNT = sum(COUNT), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(COUNT))

# Print a compact summary
print(majority_tab, n = nrow(majority_tab), width = Inf)
cat("Total pixels (majority-rule):", sum(majority_tab$COUNT), "\n")
```



# 5) Leaflet map with WMS backdrop + parcel + address marker

```{r}
# Reproject geometries (as you had)
parcel_4326 <- sf::st_transform(parcel_sf, 4326)
addr_4326   <- sf::st_transform(addr_sf,   4326)

# Compute bbox and center
bb   <- sf::st_bbox(parcel_4326)
ctr  <- sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_centroid(sf::st_union(parcel_4326)))[1, ]

# Build the map
leaflet(options = leafletOptions(worldCopyJump = FALSE)) |>
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") |>
  addWMSTiles(
    baseUrl = wms_url,
    layers  = esm_layer_id,
    options = WMSTileOptions(
      version     = "1.1.1",
      styles      = "",
      format      = "image/png",
      transparent = TRUE,
      tiled       = TRUE
    ),
    attribution = "© theLIST, State of Tasmania"
  ) |>
  addPolygons(data = parcel_4326, color = "black", weight = 2, fill = FALSE,
              popup = ~FULL_ADDRESS) |>
  addCircleMarkers(data = addr_4326, radius = 6, stroke = TRUE, weight = 1,
                   fillOpacity = 1, popup = ~FULL_ADDRESS) |>
  addLegend("topright", colors = cols, labels = classes,
            title = paste0("ESM (", target_crop, ")")) |>
  # --- IMPORTANT: strip names or use [[ ]] so these are plain numerics
  fitBounds(lng1 = as.numeric(bb["xmin"]),
            lat1 = as.numeric(bb["ymin"]),
            lng2 = as.numeric(bb["xmax"]),
            lat2 = as.numeric(bb["ymax"]))
  # If fitBounds ever fails (e.g., bbox is a point), replace with:
  # |> setView(lng = ctr[1], lat = ctr[2], zoom = 14)

```





```{r}
#| fig.width: 8
#| fig.height: 5

# ---- config ----
csv_path      <- "parcel_crop_suitability_counts_master.csv"
esm_dir       <- "ESM_Tiff/ESM_Tiff"          # folder with your local .tif
initial_crs   <- 28355
zoom_buffer_m <- 150

# ---- read one parcel from CSV (no cleaning) ----
master <- readr::read_csv(csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# choose a PID/address beforehand; we use PID here
# target_pid   <- "1700922"
# target_crop  <- "Carrot_seed"   # EXACT local basename (no extension)

row1 <- master %>%
  distinct(PID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  filter(PID == target_pid) %>%
  slice(1)
stopifnot(nrow(row1) == 1)

parcel_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(row1 %>% select(PID, FULL_ADDRESS, GEOMETRY),
                          wkt = "GEOMETRY", crs = initial_crs)
if (!all(sf::st_is_valid(parcel_sf))) parcel_sf <- sf::st_make_valid(parcel_sf)

# ---- open local GeoTIFF for target crop (no name munging) ----
tif_path <- file.path(esm_dir, paste0(target_crop, ".tif"))
if (!file.exists(tif_path)) stop("Missing GeoTIFF: ", tif_path)
r <- terra::rast(tif_path)

# ---- crop FIRST (fast), then (optionally) attach VAT to the cutout ----
bb <- sf::st_bbox(sf::st_transform(parcel_sf, sf::st_crs(r)))
ext_zoom <- terra::ext(as.numeric(bb["xmin"]) - zoom_buffer_m,
                       as.numeric(bb["xmax"]) + zoom_buffer_m,
                       as.numeric(bb["ymin"]) - zoom_buffer_m,
                       as.numeric(bb["ymax"]) + zoom_buffer_m)
r_cut <- terra::crop(r, ext_zoom)

# Optional VAT → levels (attach to the small cutout only)
vat_path <- paste0(tif_path, ".vat.dbf")
vat_lu <- NULL
if (file.exists(vat_path)) {
  vat  <- foreign::read.dbf(vat_path, as.is = TRUE)
  vcol <- grep("^value$", names(vat), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (length(vcol) == 1L) {
    lcol <- grep("(suitab|class|label|cat|legend|desc|category)",
                 names(vat), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
    if (!length(lcol)) lcol <- vcol
    vat_lu <- tibble::tibble(code = vat[[vcol]],
                             label = trimws(as.character(vat[[lcol]]))) %>%
              distinct(code, label)
    r_cut <- as.factor(r_cut)
    levels(r_cut) <- data.frame(ID = vat_lu$code, class = vat_lu$label)
  }
}

# ---- exactextract majority over parcel ----
parcel_r <- sf::st_transform(parcel_sf, sf::st_crs(r_cut))
r_rl     <- raster::raster(r_cut)
cell_df  <- exactextractr::exact_extract(r_rl, parcel_r, fun = NULL, progress = FALSE)[[1]]
stopifnot(!is.null(cell_df), nrow(cell_df) > 0)

val_col  <- setdiff(names(cell_df), c("coverage_fraction", "cell_area"))
stopifnot(length(val_col) == 1L)
cell_df  <- dplyr::rename(cell_df, value = !!val_col)

majority_tab <- cell_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(value), coverage_fraction >= 0.5) %>%
  count(value, name = "COUNT") %>%
  left_join(vat_lu %||% tibble(code=integer(),label=character()),
            by = c("value" = "code")) %>%
  transmute(PID = parcel_sf$PID,
            FULL_ADDRESS = parcel_sf$FULL_ADDRESS,
            CROP = target_crop,
            CLASS_LABEL = coalesce(label, as.character(value)),
            COUNT) %>%
  arrange(desc(COUNT))

cat(glue("Total pixels (majority-rule): {sum(majority_tab$COUNT)}\n\n"))
#print(majority_tab, n = nrow(majority_tab), width = Inf)

# ---- zoomed static map with clean legend on the RIGHT ----
{
  # 1) classify / palette prep (same as before, but silent)
  classes <- c(
    "1.0 Well suited",
    "1.1 Well suited (with soil mgmt)",
    "2.0 Suitable",
    "2.1 Suitable (with soil mgmt)",
    "3.0 Moderately suitable",
    "3.1 Moderately suitable (with soil mgmt)",
    "4.0 Unsuitable"
  )
  cols <- c("#4B0082","#5A4CB2","#62C6D4","#8CD1B6","#58C39D","#A3D98A","#FFE550")

  canon <- function(s) {
    s <- trimws(s)
    s <- gsub("management","mgmt", s, ignore.case = TRUE)
    s <- gsub("\\s+"," ", s)
    tolower(s)
  }

  cat_tbl <- try(terra::cats(r_cut, 1)[[1]], silent = TRUE)

  op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE); on.exit(par(op), add = TRUE)
  # two panels: map (wide) | legend (narrow) — captured as ONE image
  layout(matrix(c(1,2), nrow = 1), widths = c(3, 1))

  ## --- left panel: the map ---
  par(mar = c(5,5,4,2) + 0.1, xpd = NA)
  if (!inherits(cat_tbl, "try-error") && !is.null(cat_tbl)) {
    labcol <- setdiff(names(cat_tbl), c("ID","Value","value","CODE","code"))[1]
    levs   <- as.character(cat_tbl[[labcol]])
    idx    <- match(canon(levs), canon(classes))
    pal    <- rep("lightgray", length(levs))
    pal[!is.na(idx)] <- cols[idx[!is.na(idx)]]

    terra::plot(r_cut, col = pal, legend = FALSE,
                main = glue("{target_crop} suitability (zoomed on parcel)"))
  } else {
    terra::plot(r_cut, legend = FALSE,
                main = glue("{target_crop} suitability (zoomed on parcel)"))
  }
  plot(sf::st_geometry(parcel_r), add = TRUE, border = "black", lwd = 2)
  plot(sf::st_geometry(parcel_r), add = TRUE,
       col = grDevices::adjustcolor("black", alpha.f = 0.18), border = NA)
  pt <- sf::st_point_on_surface(parcel_r)
  points(sf::st_coordinates(pt), pch = 19, cex = 1.2)

  ## --- right panel: the legend only ---
  par(mar = c(5,1,4,2) + 0.1)
  plot.new()
  legend("left",
         legend = classes,
         fill   = cols,
         bty    = "n",
         cex    = 0.95,
         title  = "ESM")
}
```
